sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum in small-cap consumer names (ENZO, PADA, MBTO) while rotating out of lagging staples; the +1.01% ID outperformance vs US confirms local demand resilience. Favor companies with direct cash-conversion stories and rural distribution expansion, but trim positions into any 10%+ single-day spikes to lock gains.
